title: Compose a function pipeline
description: Composition connects one function's result to another function's input. You use $ to apply a function with fewer parentheses.

steps.description: The dot composes (+1) with (*2). You apply the addition first and the multiplication second.
The two negate expressions show the same nested application. The $ operator lets you write the nesting without parentheses.
Pointfree style defines a function without naming its input. Read this composition from right to left: map, filter, then sum.
The comments expand process on the sample list. Each line supplies the previous result to the next function.
